text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I want you to be honest with 
me. How was my run today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do not hold back. No, please don't. 
Superfluous emotions only disrupt 
calculations.
choice_data_list: We need to think about next time too, huh.

We need to think about next time too, 
right?
Are you just thinking that it's no good?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do not hold back. No, please don't. 
Superfluous emotions only disrupt 
calculations.
choice_data_list: We need to think about next time too, huh.

We need to think about next time too, 
right?
Are you just thinking that it's no good?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun. Let's hold a 
meeting as soon as we get back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It will take time, but it is necessary in 
order to win. ...I'll be counting on you.

And so, I held our post-race review 
together with Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, there's a 
problem with my running right now! That 
has to be why this was the result!
choice_data_list:
That's not an accurate grasp of the 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list:
Let's understand both the pros and the 
cons.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...So it was me who was harboring 
unnecessary sentiments all along.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I'm going to go cool my head 
for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun. For opening my 
eyes.

"...After doing a little extra running 
that day, Biwa Hayahide went to the 
meeting with a refreshed expression on her 
face."
